task: Add a current-time line to Week, fix stacked-event resize ownership with consistently placed handles, and refine the event card design using research.

items.instruction: Render one data-calendar-now indicator in today's visible hourly column, using localDate() and local wall-clock minutes / 1440 for its percentage top, plus a Current time HH:mm accessible label. Extract a reusable clock updater in this module for subsequent DOM-only refreshes; hide the indicator when today is outside days, including hidden weekends, and leave event geometry and date selection unchanged.

items.instruction: Style data-calendar-now as a 2px accent line across today's hourly column, with a 6px leading dot and a compact HH:mm label on the shared surface colour. Position it by percentage within the day so zoom stays accurate; keep it below active resize controls, pointer-events:none, inside the column at midnight and narrow widths, and legible in light/dark themes without adding a scrolling container.

items.instruction: Give Week timed events stable active-event ownership: mouse hover or keyboard focus reveals that event's resize controls, and a touch long press selects it without opening its editor or blocking a prior swipe. Resolve the chosen event and endpoint before pointer capture and retain both throughout the drag so an adjacent event cannot steal its edge. Clear selection and temporary layers on cancellation, outside dismissal, redraw or view change; preserve ordinary clicks, keyboard resizing, source permissions and cross-day resize behavior.

items.instruction: Keep the start handle at the top-left and the end handle at the bottom-right at every event height; remove the max-height:44px position switch. Show small accent grips only for the hovered, focused or touch-selected event, giving that event priority above neighbors and disabling inactive overlapping hit areas. Keep shared control-height targets, including 44px on touch, keyboard focus and ns-resize feedback; separate the two targets even on short or narrow events without changing their displayed duration.

items.anchor: .calendar-timed-card > .calendar-card-title { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 0 !important; padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--task-field-color) 55%, var(--line)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--task-field-color) 12%, var(--surface)); border-radius: var(--field-radius); font-size: var(--type-small); overflow: hidden; }
items.instruction: Refine the hourly event card as one coherent style: a subtle status-tinted surface, neutral 1px boundary and 3px status-colour leading stripe, shared field-radius corners, 4px/8px inner spacing, a 600-weight title and quieter tabular time text. Keep the existing two-pixel separation and accurate time geometry; shorten content before it clips in tiny cards, retain shared field boxes where they fit, and preserve done styling, Compact mode, hidden fields, theme contrast and focus rings. Reserve stronger borders or shadows for the active event.
